STRATEGY: Parent retaliates if last opponent action was D, otherwise cooperates with occasional late/behind defections. Simulated parent against one_D_TFT, four_D_TFT, four_D_ALLC, sustained_D, periodic_D probes. Changed toward a probe-and-exploit strategy: cooperate early, defect to test for always-C, exploit if no retaliation, otherwise use forgiving TFT and defect on the last round.

So our strategy might be slightly worse against periodic_D."
STRATEGY: The parent cooperates initially, probes by defecting around round 3, exploits opponents that never defect, and otherwise uses a forgiving TFT-like recovery mode. The trace simulates this against forgiving TFT, always-D, periodic-D, and always-C, tracing round-by-round payoffs and oscillations. It revises the TFT mode's forgiveness/punishment rules to avoid C,D/D,C oscillation and to punish persistent defection while still recovering after its own probe.

The trace simulates the parent against TFT, always-C, periodic-D, and always-D, then revises the recovery rule to distinguish unprovoked defections from provoked ones, changing the strategy to use TFT after opp_def > 0 unless the strategy itself defected while the opponent cooperated in the last two rounds.

STRATEGY: Parent strategy is revised into a deterministic rule: cooperate first, defect on the final round, exploit an always-cooperating opponent via a probe/test/exploit schedule, and otherwise use TFT with recovery from unprovoked defections. Simulated against TFT probes, always C, always D, periodic_D, and slot 2. Changed by adding an opp_def==0 exploit branch, a last-2-round unprovoked-defection recovery check, and a final-round defection.
